academicCheckpoint.prevention: Epidemiology & Public Health includes health promotion, needs assessment, screening and intervention implementation. Medical & Health Psychology adds prevention and behaviour change. Public Policy Analysis, Governance of Sustainability, qualitative inquiry and persuasion support policy, determinants and communication, with differing domain scope. These contributions warrant reassessment at the revisit rather than rejecting the direction solely for absence of a dedicated public health policy title.

ENSDELT312.title: Governance of Sustainability
ENSDELT312.content: Institutions, actors and power; Collective action and common-pool resources; Governance modes and networks; Techno-optimism and ecological limits; Climate justice; Populism and environmental politics; Wicked and long-term problems; Public participation; Food, water and energy governance; Markets, public goods and externalities; Adaptive and global governance; Climate mitigation; Policy effectiveness and feasibility
ENSDELT312.methods: Governance-framework application; Problem diagnosis and causal analysis; Stakeholder and policy-option matrices; Policy evaluation; Policy-advice memo development; Stakeholder and expert interviewing; Comparative analysis of normative policy perspectives

GOSPOLI312.title: Public Policy Analysis
GOSPOLI312.content: Investigates public policy in the context of globalization. Uses a case study on sugar to examine policy‑making phases and alternative conceptualisations across national and international arenas. Students write policy memos.

GOSSOCI212.methods: Qualitative research design; Interviews; Focus groups; Ethnography and participant observation; Documentary and archival analysis; Visual-data analysis; Participatory video and drawing; Transcription; Qualitative coding; Thematic analysis; NVivo-supported analysis; Reflexive methodological evaluation
